data.body: Implemented the README-only installation contract corrections. Separated the Git runtime prerequisite from the Git 2.38 development, test, and CI floor, cited .github/git-version-floor.txt, and documented the optional S3 repair requirement. Documented pyyaml>=6, jsonschema>=4.18, referencing>=0.30, mcp>=1.28.1,<2, and pyjwt[crypto]>=2.10,<3. Added referencing to both installation comments. Clarified the Anthropic, Bedrock, OpenAI, and Google provider installation boundaries. Verification passed: python scripts/check_docs_index.py --check; python -m pytest tests/unit/test_git_version_floor.py -q with 29 passed; python scripts/check_readme_quickstart.py with PASS. Scope audit against origin/main reports only README.md modified, and git diff --check is clean.
